name: Break Ups
overview: Scripture acknowledges that life is marked by seasons and changes, including the painful experience of break ups, as Ecclesiastes 3:1 reminds us that there is a time for every purpose under heaven. In the midst of such trials, believers can find hope in God's sovereign plans for peace and a hopeful future, as Jeremiah 29:11 assures us. While broken relationships may result from the works of the flesh such as adultery and uncleanness described in Galatians 5:19, God's pure and trustworthy word serves as a shield for those who place their trust in Him, offering comfort and guidance through difficult transitions (Proverbs 30:5).
